# Nature's Ward (`features:land-natures-ward`)
**Class:** [Druid](../classes/druid.md) | **Subclass:** [Circle of the Land](../subclasses/circle-of-the-land.md) | **Level:** [Druid 10](../levels/druid-10.md)

You are immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice in the Circle Spells feature, as shown in the Nature's Ward table.

Nature's Ward
Land Type / Resistance
Arid / Fire
Polar / Cold
Temperate / Lightning
Tropical / Poison
